text:
Olivia Chen: quick async standup — onboarding + evals handoff. What I did: finished data adapters for the spanish promptset, ran a full eval sweep on tinyq-2 and uploaded results to the dashboard. Blockers: noticed ~6% degradation on hallucination metric for one intent (dates). Today: triage that regression, open a PR for prompt tweaks, pinging @Misha for code review, and handing off smoke tests to night shift.

Rajan Kumar: thanks. Saw the eval results — looks like the drop correlates with the new tokenizer edge-case where "enero" gets split. I can repro locally with a small script. I'll attach a short repro and a suggested tokenizer patch in the PR.

Misha Patel: @Olivia I can review the prompt tweaks this afternoon. Quick ask — can you add a tiny failing example in the PR description so it's obvious what we want fixed? also add the eval id (eval/2026-04-12-olivia-spanish).

Olivia Chen: yep will add the failing examples and the eval id. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboard/pull/812 — it's small, focused on prompt normalization + a doc note.

Sam Torres: small logistics: can the night-shift pair (Rajan + Sam) get the smoke-run checklist? I'll copy it to the QA board and assign. Couple items: run `./tests/smoke_spanish.sh --sample 100` and validate dates/anchors.

Rajan Kumar: added a quick repro snippet to the PR and one-line patch to tokenizer for review. local test: ```python repro.py --text "3 de enero"``` reproduces split.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #812 — 3 jobs queued, ETA ~12m.

Misha Patel: I'll pick this up after lunch. If CI is green, can we do a canary rollout to staging? prefer a smallcanary tag so we can monitor hallucination signal on the dashboard.

Olivia Chen: yep plan: if PR passes, staging canary (10%) for 1h, watch hallucination + latency. If things look good, roll to full staging then prod. I'll post canary windows here.

Sam Torres: pinging @Rajan — if you want, I can take the handoff for the night smoke-run; otherwise you'll lead.

Rajan Kumar: I'll lead the handoff remotely, will be online for the first 30m of the run. Sam can own the follow-ups.

Olivia Chen: cool, thanks all. tiny checklist for PR to merge: add failing example, eval id, confirm CI green, add canary tag. I'll update the onboarding doc after merge. :thumbsup:

Misha Patel: :thumbsup: rolling in a few hours.
